searchLog: 8th consecutive day (Aug 5-11, now Aug 12) of total WebFetch egress block in this environment. Re-confirmed today, domain-agnostic: WebFetch against databricks.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io (scaleai, xai), anthropic.com/careers/jobs, api.ashbyhq.com (openai), and metacareers.com all returned {"error_type":"EGRESS_BLOCKED","message":"Access to <domain> is blocked by the network egress proxy."}. Escalated to a raw curl test outside the tool layer to rule out a WebFetch-specific bug: curl through the session's own HTTPS_PROXY (127.0.0.1:46425, per /root/.ccr/status) to www.databricks.com, api.ashbyhq.com, jobs.ashbyhq.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io, news.google.com, and even example.com all returned an identical 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' from the proxy itself -- a domain-agnostic policy block, not a per-site issue, and not something a retry or different tool fixes (the proxy's own README says explicitly: do not retry 403/407 policy denials). The Google Drive connector, unaffected by this proxy, worked fine and confirmed the master resume corpus. WebSearch also still works and surfaced live-looking leads (Databricks APM New Grad 2027, Scale AI Strategic Projects Lead New Grad, OpenAI FDE roles) but per the honesty rules a search snippet cannot confirm a posting is open now, eligible, and free -- that requires loading the real page, which remains impossible from inside this run. Zero verified opportunities is the correct output under these conditions, not a search failure. This is now an 8-day unresolved pattern with no sign of self-resolving; it needs a fix at the environment/routine network-policy level (allowlist greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co, workable.com, and target company career-page domains for WebFetch/egress), since it cannot be worked around from inside a run.
